title: Abbas karbala ki
body:
Abbas karbala ki
abbas alamdar     5
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas karbala ki zarurat hai dosto
abbas murtaza ki riyadat hai dosto
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ambiya ki karamat hai dosto
abbas zulfikare imamat hai dosto
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas jaisa koi nhi iss jahan me
maula hussain rehte hai iski amaan me    3
<<DIVIDER>>
koi bayan kaise kare iska martaba
isko salaam karta hai maryam ka ladlaa
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas khud hai teesra beta butul ka
ye raaz aaj tak na zamana samajh saka
<<DIVIDER>>
beta ise butul ne yubhi banaya hai
mohsin k badle deher me abbas aaya hai  3
<<DIVIDER>>
masoomiyat ka shak hai jinhe iski zaat me
inka jawab hai ye meri diniyat me
<<DIVIDER>>
hargiz koi kami nhi iski sifaak me
baade hussain hota agar qaynat me
<<DIVIDER>>
milti ise imamat isika mukaam tha
sajjad ki kasam yahi chautha imam tha    3
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise aaya ho iska bhala kya mukam hai
haatho me iske dono jaha ka nizam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
iske liye ye baat zamane me aam hai
abbas bas akela wafa ka imam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dono jaha me markade hai saas ek hai
zahra k khandan me abbas ek hai           3
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din khuda se kehne lagi binte mustafa
rohul amin ko mere ghar bhejde khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
chakki chalaye aake mujhe kaam hai zara
yaad aaraha hai aaj mujhe ek bawafa
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hai mukam iska jaha ko batana hai
abbas k liye mujhe kurta banana hai        3
<<DIVIDER>>
isko imamato ne galese lagaya hai
shere khuda ne isko duao se paya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ko butul ne beta banaya hai
sajjad ne ye raaz jaha ko bataya hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye fel har bashar ko bajaal aana chahiye
ghazi ka naam aaye to uth jana chahiye    3
<<DIVIDER>>
dee ka alam rasul ne hamza ko tha diya
hamza k baad jafare tayyar ko mila
<<DIVIDER>>
jafar se haath o haath li ko ataa hua
ghazi k paas aate hi ghazi hogaya
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala k baad kisi ko mila nhi
ghazi k haath chhod k parcham gaya nhi   3
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad kya bayan ho abbas ka mukam
iska rasule paak b karte hai ehteram
<<DIVIDER>>
bheja hai isko madare shabbir ne salaam
iska qasida padhte hai khud waqt k imam
<<DIVIDER>>
baade zarur dekhna wo waqt aayega
hajj karne kaba rozaye ghazi pe jayega     3
author: Muqtar Hussain
